summary: ZTO Express filed a Form 6-K with Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing open-market repurchases of its American depositary shares (ADSs). The company bought back 73,128 ADSs on August 12, 2026 at USD 22.98 per share, 218,268 on August 13 at USD 22.89, 218,091 on August 14 at USD 22.91, and 218,381 on August 17 at USD 22.88. The buybacks represent approximately 0.03% of issued shares per transaction and are pending cancellation. The registrant confirmed board authorization and compliance with listing rules. What to watch: continuation of the repurchase program's pace and any impact on ADS liquidity.
